summary.text: Eugene Miller is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
He previously served on the Cleveland City Council from 2009 to 2013.

paragraphs.text: Eugene Miller earned a B.A. in sociology from Baldwin Wallace College and has worked as the proprietor of Miller Mosely Company.
According to Ballotpedia, he served in the Ohio House of Representatives for District 10 from 2007 to 2009 and then on the Cleveland City Council from 2009 to 2013.
Miller sought the Democratic nomination for the District 10 House seat in 2014 and lost to incumbent Bill Patmon, 63.2 percent to 36.8 percent.
In 2017 he lost the general election for the Ward 10 seat on the Cleveland City Council to Anthony Hairston, 64.05 percent to 35.79 percent.
Miller won the 2026 Democratic primary for District 20 with 50.9 percent of the vote in a four-candidate field.
